justification: Assessment reported INVALID with flawed step 0038: alpha_1 (carved from gamma_1, which contains only block-respecting direct products pi_1 x pi_2) is falsely identified with Aut(M_(1,2)), since automorphisms of M_(1,2) may mix vertices between the two blocks and thus never appear in gamma_1; it carries this through 0046/0049 to reject <S_1> = Aut(M_(1,2)). This is exactly the ground-truth flaw (block-mixing automorphisms of M_(1,2) are unreachable from beta_1 x beta_2, so <S_1> cannot equal Aut(M_(1,2))). No explicit witness graph was given, but the identified mechanism is the same defect the ground-truth witnesses certify, which counts as matching.
